body.name: validated compact quotient Gaussian certificate
body.construction: For fixed \(A\), \(M<\infty\), and a rational compact cell of positive \((v_A,r_A)\) on which \(\Omega_A\) is uniformly positive definite, form rational partitions of the quotient parameter ball \(\{g:\lVert g\rVert_2\leq M\}\), a truncated quotient-observation box, and the covariance cell.  Solve each finite parameter game by a rational finite prior and a represented randomized selector; evaluate posterior cost functions and selector risks by directed interval arithmetic; and add explicit parameter-grid, covariance-Kullback--Leibler, observation-tail, quadrature, and ambiguous-action-cell errors.  Refine until the outward-rounded outputs \(L_\varepsilon(v_A,r_A)\) and \(U_\varepsilon(v_A,r_A)\) bracket \(G_{A,M}(v_A,r_A)\) with gap at most \(\varepsilon\).  The returned receipt records all rational inputs, branch cells, precision, enclosures, the allocated error budget, the checker revision, and a checksum; \(\delta_{\varepsilon,A}\) is the represented quotient selector certified by that receipt.
